description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing invoices in a customer management and billing system. It handles listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, exporting invoices, and generating balance sheets, interfacing with SQLAlchemy models and a database session.

methods.name: list_invoices( customer_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by customer ID"), status_: Optional[str] = Query(None, alias="status", description="Filter by status"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all invoices with optional filters by customer or status.

methods.name: get_invoice( invoice_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific invoice by ID.

methods.name: create_invoice( invoice: models.InvoiceCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new invoice along with its items.

methods.name: update_invoice( invoice_id: int, body: models.InvoiceBase, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update main details of an existing invoice.

methods.name: delete_invoice( invoice_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an invoice and all related data.

methods.name: export_invoices( export_type: str = Query("pdf", enum=["pdf", "excel"], description="Export type"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to export invoices as PDF or Excel.

methods.name: balance_sheet( from_date: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)"), to_date: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="End date (YYYY-MM-DD)"), customer_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by customer ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to generate a balance sheet report with filters.
